name: Natsunone -Ring-
source:
The quiet seaside town of Yurigahama is known for its private school that provides female athletes for swimming tournaments on national level.
This year school suffers a huge defeat at preliminary competitions, and only ace of girl team Hoshizaki Anon gets a ticket to the nationals.
Her childhood friend boy Hibiki dreams of nationals himself, but after three years of training these dreams gets defeated in an instant. 
He starts to re-evaluate his life and affinity to the sports. 
At the same time there is a new face - Suzuna - in the girl swimming team. She is very talented and inspires great hopes for the team. 
This bittersweet summer Hibiki, Anon and Suzuna will spend alongside.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
安靜的海濱小鎮百合濱以其私立學校而聞名，該學校為女運動員提供參加國家級游泳比賽的機會。
今年學校在預賽中慘敗，只有女隊王牌星崎阿農獲得了全國賽的入場券。
她兒時的朋友男孩響也夢想著打進全國大賽，但經過三年的訓練，這些夢想瞬間破滅。
他開始重新評估自己的生活和對運動的熱愛。
與此同時，女子游泳隊中出現了一位新面孔——鈴奈。她非常有才華，給團隊帶來了很大的希望。
這個苦樂參半的夏天，響、阿農和鈴奈將一起度過。
